title: Providers
description: A bundle of healthcare provider records. The Providers wrapper holds a 'provider' array. To use the inner provider as a MongoDB $jsonSchema collection validator, target '#/definitions/provider' and replace 'type' with 'bsonType' throughout. Required fields: npi, loaded_at. Every other field is optional. Patterns and enums constrain the shape of values that are present.

provider.description: ChatHealthy.AI's proprietary provider record. It contains an array of provider records. May be empty.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: A healthcare provider record sourced from the NPPES NPI Registry, enriched with per-address county / urban data and proprietary classification flags. Required: npi (NPPES business key) and loaded_at (dispatcher-stamped at message dispatch).

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId — auto-assigned on insert. Omit on write; always present on read.

npi.description: National Provider Identifier — 10-digit string, globally unique, issued by CMS. Never numeric; leading zeros are significant. THE record's business key.

loaded_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the pipeline load. One value for the entire job, stipulated at the beginning of the job, so every record written by one run carries the same value.

load_id.description: Identifier of the pipeline run that wrote this record. Populated with the Workbook Job ID. Provenance -- use npi as the stable identifier across runs.

entity_type_code.description: NPI entity type. '1' = individual practitioner. '2' = organization (hospital, pharmacy, group practice, etc.).

provider_enumeration_date.description: Date the NPI was issued by CMS. Format: MM/DD/YYYY (as received from NPPES CSV; not converted to ISO 8601).

last_update_date.description: Date the NPI record was last updated in the NPPES registry. Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

certification_date.description: Date the provider last certified their NPI record with CMS. Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

active.description: Inactivity event log for this NPI. OPTIONAL: absence = the provider is currently active AND has never had an inactivity incident in NPPES. PRESENT = the provider is currently inactive OR has been inactive at some point in the past (even if later reactivated). Each entry records one deactivation or reactivation event with the NPPES date. The current active state is computed by an evaluator function that walks the event log (latest deactivated/reactivated determines current status); the schema records the events, the function makes the call. Subsumes the former top-level npi_deactivation_date / npi_reactivation_date fields — their data lives in this event log.

date.description: Event date (MM/DD/YYYY) as reported by NPPES.

is_active.description: Provider's active state AFTER this event. event='deactivated' yields false; event='reactivated' yields true. Default true if absent (a default that satisfies the conceptual 'absence means active' contract; in practice this field is required on every event so the default rarely applies).

source.description: Where this event was learned (typically 'nppes_deactivation_date' or 'nppes_reactivation_date').

taxonomies.description: Provider specialty taxonomy codes (NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy). Each type-1 provider has at least one NUCC code. Each entry is {code, code_label} -- the labels-alongside-codes rule (LLD v39 sec. 7.1). The primary designator is stored top-level as primary_taxonomy_code (per NPPES Readme v.2 sec. 1.1: primary is a per-NPI fact, not a per-taxonomy attribute).

code.description: The taxonomy code as reported by CMS/NPPES for a `reported` element, or the canonical NUCC code for a `canonical_derived` element.

code_label.description: Human-readable display for the code. Sourced from NUCC when reference_status=current_reference; sourced from the proprietary F-105 repair entry otherwise.

taxonomy_role.description: `reported` = code as directly reported by CMS/NPPES; `canonical_derived` = code introduced by an approved F-105 canonical mapping. Both roles may coexist on the same provider when a repair carries an approved mapping.

reference_status.description: Where this code stands relative to the current NUCC release. current_reference=present in current NUCC; historical_reference=present in a prior NUCC release, no longer published; records_registry_only=present in CMS/NPPES but never in NUCC; locally_curated=proprietary code not sourced from NUCC; unresolved=code present in neither NUCC nor the F-105 catalog.

authority.description: Which authority attests this specific code on this provider. CMS_NPPES for `reported` elements; NUCC for `canonical_derived` elements.

related_taxonomy.description: Link to a companion taxonomy element on the same provider. Present on `reported` elements when an approved canonical mapping exists (points at the `canonical_derived` twin), and on `canonical_derived` elements to point back at the `reported` source.

relationship.description: Semantics of the relationship. Modeled after HL7 FHIR R5 ConceptMap relationship codes.

status.description: Optional. 'Supplemented' when this code is in the F-105 supplement catalog (absent from current NUCC); description peers (grouping/classification/specialization/definition) are also stamped on the element. 'Missing' when the code is in neither current NUCC nor F-105 (recorded to the discrepancy report). Absent = normal NUCC-backed. See NUCC_SpecialtyCodeDataDiscrepancyManagement.docx.

primary_taxonomy_code.description: The single NUCC taxonomy code NPPES designates as the provider's primary specialty. Lifted from the NPPES per-slot Primary Taxonomy Switch columns by normalize_provider_rows. LLD v39 sec. 7.1.

is_primary_care.description: Type-1 only. True iff any Healthcare Provider Primary Taxonomy Switch_N = 'Y' on the source NPPES record. Absent on type-2 records. Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

licenses.description: Optional. Omitted when NPPES reported no license slots.

state.description: US state abbreviation where the license was issued.

state_label.description: Full state name for the two-letter state code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

number.description: License number as reported by the provider to CMS.

other_identifiers.description: Legacy or alternate provider identifiers (UPIN, Medicaid, Medicare OSCAR, payer-issued IDs, etc.). One object per identifier slot from NPPES; type_description is derived from type_code via the OID_TYPE_DESCRIPTIONS dictionary. Includes insurance-bearing facts (Medicaid IDs, named-issuer fields like 'BLUE SHIELD') that are consumer-facing signals about which insurance a provider takes.

identifier.description: The identifier value as reported in NPPES.

type_code.description: Type code as reported in NPPES. Two-character string. Common values: '01' = Other, '05' = Medicaid.

type_description.description: Human-readable type label derived from type_code via OID_TYPE_DESCRIPTIONS. Present when type_code is in the dictionary.

state.description: State associated with this identifier (e.g. the state that issued a state Medicaid ID).

issuer.description: Issuing organization. Free-form string from NPPES.

bad_data.description: Fields this record could not load. One entry per field that failed, so the flag and the reasons are one object rather than two arrays held in step by position.

attribute.description: Fully qualified attribute name, dotted from the record root.

reason.description: Why this attribute is bad data. Controlled vocabulary (CV-001 bad_data_reasons).

value.description: The offending value as received, or the string 'NULL' when there was none.

can_prescribe.description: True if any of this provider's NUCC taxonomies has prescribing authority per the proprietary catalog (ProprietaryData.SpecialtyAndProviderFlags). OR across taxonomies. entity_type_code='2' (organization) short-circuits to false. Computed by provider_flags_enrichment.compute_provider_flags.

is_homeopathic.description: True if any of this provider's NUCC taxonomies is classified as homeopathic per the proprietary catalog. OR across taxonomies. entity_type_code='2' (organization) short-circuits to false.

provider_last_name_legal_name.description: Provider's legal last name as registered with CMS. Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

provider_first_name.description: Provider's first name. Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

provider_middle_name.description: Provider's middle name or initial. Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

provider_name_prefix_text.description: Name prefix (e.g. 'Dr.', 'Mr.'). Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

provider_name_suffix_text.description: Name suffix (e.g. 'Jr.', 'III'). Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

provider_credential_text.description: Professional credential suffix (e.g. 'M.D.', 'D.O.', 'R.N.'). Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

provider_sex_code.description: Provider sex as reported to CMS. Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

provider_sex_code_label.description: Human-readable label for provider_sex_code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1). Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

is_sole_proprietor.description: Whether the individual provider operates as a sole proprietor ('Y'/'N'). Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

is_sole_proprietor_label.description: Human-readable label for is_sole_proprietor (LLD v39 sec. 7.1). Individual practitioners only; absent on entity_type_code '2'.

provider_organization_name_legal_busines.description: Legal business name of the organization. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

provider_other_organization_name.description: Alternate or DBA name for the organization. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

provider_other_organization_name_type_co.description: Type code for provider_other_organization_name. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

employer_identification_number_ein.description: Federal EIN for the organization. May be '<UNAVAIL>' if CMS could not obtain it. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

is_organization_subpart.description: Whether this organization is a subpart of a larger organization ('Y'/'N'). Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

parent_organization_lbn.description: Legal business name of the parent organization. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

parent_organization_tin.description: Tax Identification Number of the parent organization. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

authorized_official_last_name.description: Last name of the authorized official responsible for the NPI record. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

authorized_official_first_name.description: First name of the authorized official. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

authorized_official_middle_name.description: Middle name of the authorized official. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

authorized_official_title_or_position.description: Job title or position of the authorized official. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

authorized_official_telephone_number.description: Phone number of the authorized official. Digits only, no formatting. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

authorized_official_credential_text.description: Professional credential of the authorized official. Organizations only; absent on entity_type_code '1'.

urban.description: The provider's urban marker, rolled up from the most urban of the provider's practice addresses (the lowest USDA RUCC). True where that RUCC is 1, 2 or 3. Absent when no practice address resolved a RUCC.

allOf.description: Type 1 individual practitioners: name + sex + sole-proprietor flag required. Organization and authorized-official fields are forbidden -- they were absent from every Type 1 record sampled.

Type 2 organizations: organization name + EIN + authorized-official quartet + is_organization_subpart required. Individual name, sex and sole-proprietor fields are forbidden -- they were absent from every Type 2 record sampled. Nested: if is_organization_subpart='Y', parent_organization_lbn and parent_organization_tin become required.

county.title: CountyEnrichment
county.description: Result of the county enrichment pipeline for one practice address. Includes a derived urban flag from USDA Rural-Urban Continuum Codes (RUCC 1-3 -> urban=true, RUCC 4-9 -> urban=false).

fips.description: 5-digit FIPS county code (2-digit state + 3-digit county). Null when enrichment failed (source carries one of the geocoder_pass*_failed labels) or the address is excluded (out_of_scope*). Example: '30063' = Missoula County, MT.

name.description: Human-readable county name (e.g. 'Missoula County'). Present when fips is set via crosswalk or Maps. Absent for some sources (e.g. Census batch geocoder does not return county name).

source.description: Which enrichment pass assigned the county. Determines reliability and method of the assignment. Deterministic — no separate 'reason' is needed except for the out_of_scope_zip_state_mismatch case captured in the `reason` field below.

x-enum-descriptions.crosswalk_pass1: ZIP -> county via ZipCountyCrosswalk (res_ratio >= 0.98). Fastest path, ~82% of providers.
x-enum-descriptions.crosswalk_zip_fixed: ZIP crosswalk applied after zip_state_mismatch detection corrected the state.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass2_batch: U.S. Census Geocoder batch API on practice address.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass2_batch_billing: U.S. Census Geocoder batch API on practice address with mailing fallback (legacy combined Pass 2 path).
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass2_failed: Pass 2 (Census batch on practice address) gave up. Recovery resumes at pass 3.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass3_billing: U.S. Census Geocoder batch API on mailing/billing address (Pass 2 fallback).
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass3_failed: Pass 3 (Census batch on billing address) gave up. Recovery resumes at pass 4.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass4_maps: Google Maps Geocoding API on practice address. Paid API.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass4_failed: Pass 4 (Google Maps on practice address) gave up. Recovery resumes at pass 6.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass5_maps_billing: Google Maps Geocoding API on billing address. Paid API.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass6_nppes: NPI looked up in NPPES registry; returned address tried against ZIP crosswalk.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_pass6_failed: Pass 6 (NPPES last-resort) gave up. Chain exhausted; address remains un-countyed until the next monthly pipeline run.
x-enum-descriptions.geocoder_no_address: Address has no usable line1 / city to geocode.
x-enum-descriptions.out_of_scope: Address (or provider) excluded from enrichment. See 'reason' for the criterion.
x-enum-descriptions.out_of_scope_zip_state_mismatch: This address's ZIP does not match its state and license-based repair did not resolve it.

zip_ratio.description: Residential population ratio of the ZIP-to-county mapping used (0.0-1.0), from ZipCountyCrosswalk.res_ratio. 1.0 = the ZIP lies entirely within this county; below 1.0 = a split ZIP, the fraction of residents in THIS county. Collected when available.

urban.description: Urban-vs-rural classification of the county. True = urban (USDA Rural-Urban Continuum Code 1-3). False = rural (RUCC 4-9). Derived from USDA Ruralurbancontinuumcodes2023.xlsx per EPIC-010-F-007-S-011-REQ-T-002.

business_address.title: BusinessAddress
business_address.description: The NPPES mailing/billing address. Exactly one per provider. An entity in its own right, not a variant of a practice address: it carries no county enrichment, because county and urban are properties of where care is delivered, not of where post is sent.

address_type.description: Discriminator. 'business' = the NPPES mailing/billing address. 'mailing' = legacy alias occasionally present.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory abbreviation.

state_label.description: Full state name for the two-letter state code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code. Stored as a string to preserve leading zeros. Truncated from any ZIP+4 input at parse time.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. 'US' for domestic providers. Foreign values trigger out_of_scope with reason 'foreign_provider'.

country_code_label.description: Full country name for the ISO country code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

phone.description: Phone number as reported by NPPES. Digits only or with formatting as received.

phone_ext.description: Phone number extension. Collected explicitly rather than inferred.

fax.description: Fax number as reported by NPPES.

practice_address.title: PracticeAddress
practice_address.description: A location where care is delivered. Carries the county enrichment and the urban flag derived from USDA Rural-Urban Continuum Codes. An entity in its own right, independent of the business address.

address_type.description: Discriminator. 'practice' = the NPPES primary practice location. 'secondary_practice' = a practice location appended from pl_pfile_*.csv.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory abbreviation.

state_label.description: Full state name for the two-letter state code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code. Stored as a string to preserve leading zeros. Truncated from any ZIP+4 input at parse time.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. 'US' for domestic providers. Foreign values trigger out_of_scope with reason 'foreign_provider'.

country_code_label.description: Full country name for the ISO country code (LLD v39 sec. 7.1).

phone.description: Phone number as reported by NPPES. Digits only or with formatting as received.

phone_ext.description: Phone number extension. Collected explicitly rather than inferred.

fax.description: Fax number as reported by NPPES.
